premises.text: Managing community organizations across separate event, email, and member tools is too hard
premises.evidence_span: managing those organizations has been incredibly challenging. I've had to use five platforms to stay organized

premises.text: One platform can serve any community type with communication, events, members, transactions, chapters, and social interaction
premises.evidence_span: Cohort is for any type of community. It's for mommy groups, alumni groups, hiking groups, you name it

premises.text: Membership directory and profiles let organizers and members find each other
premises.evidence_span: It's a full membership directory, and each member has a complete member profile, meaning you and your members can actually find each other when you search

premises.text: Transaction management handles event fees and multi-tier dues without cash handling
premises.evidence_span: You'll never have to touch cash. Event fees, dues, taken care of. You can also create numerous tiers of dues

premises.text: Online chapter hierarchy keeps local leadership autonomous without losing organizer control
premises.evidence_span: enabling your local leadership to operate completely autonomously without you losing control

premises.text: Freemium monetization via channel and premium subscriptions plus transaction service fees
premises.evidence_span: We generate revenue by selling subscriptions against our channels in free groups. We generate subscription revenue for our premium groups. And we generate service fees revenue at any time we conduct a transaction

value.text: Organizers engage membership through one community-connecting solution
value.evidence_span: Cohort connects community. What I mean by that, it is the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership

causal_links.evidence_span: the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership
for the vast majority of groups, it's entirely free
